mapper.select: SELECT s.sido_no FROM sido s WHERE REPLACE(s.sido_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{sidoName}, ' ', ''), '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(s.sido_name) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT g.gungu_code FROM gungu g WHERE g.sido_no = #{sidoNo} AND REPLACE(g.gungu_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{gunguName}, ' ', ''), '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(g.gungu_name) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT sbi.image_id AS imageId, sbi.board_id AS boardId, sbi.menu_id AS menuId, sbi.image_url AS imageUrl, sbi.image_order AS imageOrder, sbi.created_at AS createdAt, sbi.menu_rating AS menuRating, sbi.one_line_review AS oneLineReview, m.menu_name AS menuName FROM sns_board_image sbi LEFT JOIN menu m ON sbi.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY image_order ASC
